category_edits.rationale: Smoothly bound only the exclusive mask embedding as m / sqrt(1 + ||m||²), preserving its learnable direction and magnitude. Real-item normalization at radius multiplier 0.75, tying, frequency modulation, topology, loss and optimizer remain unchanged. The predictor imports this model definition, so training and inference use identical embeddings with unchanged checkpoint shapes across all four categories.

change_summary: Apply smooth magnitude bounding exclusively to the mask-token embedding in each category’s single BERT4Rec model.
